description: This file is a C++ source file implementing an Android application using Vulkan for graphics rendering. It manages application lifecycle events, window handling, and rendering loop within the Android environment.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Holds the application state, including whether drawing is active and a unique pointer to the Vulkan sample.

methods.name: OnAppCmd
methods.description: Handles Android application commands such as start, init window, terminate window, and destroy, updating the application state accordingly.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Main loop of the application, processes events, manages rendering, and handles cleanup.
